					areachart("", options, frames_graph_data, "linechart_div_remaining_frames_public_by_hour");
					
					var frames_per_hour = 2548.25;
					if (frames_per_hour > 0) {
						var total_frames = 109893627;
						var interval = 500;
						frames_per_interval = frames_per_hour*interval/3600000;
						setInterval(function() {
						total_frames = total_frames + frames_per_interval;
						$('#total_frames').html(Math.floor(total_frames).toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ","));
						}, interval);
					}
				</script><script src="https://www.google.com/uds/?file=visualization&amp;v=1.0&amp;packages=corechart" type="text/javascript"></script><link href="https://www.google.com/uds/api/visualization/1.0/36558b280aac4fa99ed8215e60015cff/ui+en.css" rel="stylesheet" type="text/css"/><script src="https://www.google.com/uds/api/visualization/1.0/36558b280aac4fa99ed8215e60015cff/format+en,default+en,ui+en,corechart+en.I.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
</div>
</div>
